# gtme answer

Record a participant's answer for one pending human/* or agent/* step: a filter takes pass=true|false and reason, a compose or review its declared fields; the value is validated against the step's declared outputs and refused naming them otherwise. Writes an `answered` event and nothing else — it never sends. STEP may be omitted when one step is pending; with no identity key and a terminal it walks the pending records. --as names the participant (default the OS user; the human/ or agent/ prefix follows the adapter), --cost records what the participant spent (estimated unless --measured), --note is free text kept with the answer (never part of a cache key)

## Forms

```
gtme answer [RUN_ID|last|PIPELINE] [STEP] [IDENTITY_KEY] [--set field=value ...] [--as NAME] [--cost USD [--measured]] [--note TEXT]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--set` | `field=value` | See the form. |
| `--as` | `NAME` | --as names the participant (default the OS user; the human/ or agent/ prefix follows the adapter) |
| `--cost` | `USD` | --cost records what the participant spent (estimated unless --measured) |
| `--measured` | nothing | --cost records what the participant spent (estimated unless --measured) |
| `--note` | `TEXT` | --note is free text kept with the answer (never part of a cache key) |

It exits with one of the [exit codes](/reference/cli#exit-codes) every verb shares.

## Example

From [Participants](/concepts/participants):

```sh
gtme answer grading grade jane.doe@acme.com --set grading.grade=A \
    --note "owns the budget" --as dana
```
